generated_by: build_event_flyer.py (python-pptx), geometry and budgets computed per profile; budgets measured with the brand TTFs, 8% slack for Arial
notes: Tabloid: 11 x 17 in, read from a hallway board, 3 to 6 ft. Letter is the master grid; Tabloid keeps the Letter proportions at 1.294x width with type at about 1.55x; 17 x 22 is a flat 2x with every size at or above the 24 pt poster floor. Do not derive one size from another by scaling a built file when a profile exists; use the profile.

Fields are addressed by name. A spec may also give "workflow": [["Title", "detail"], ...] (spread over step1-step3), "tools": [{"label", "image", "alt"}] (icons + plain product names in the tools row) and "registration_qr": {"qr": {"url", "size_in"}} or "qr": {...} (QR generated by scripts/qr_code.py).

Defaults: agenda_title = "What you will do" when agenda is given; tools_label = "TOOLS COVERED" when tools are given; registration_label = "SCAN TO REGISTER" and registration_url = the QR address without https:// when a QR is given. Unfilled placeholders are deleted by new_deck.py.
Third-party product icons in the tools row are kept as supplied, with plain product names, and stay separate from the host signatures (ATR and Kent State) and any sponsor logos.

layouts.name: Workshop flyer
layouts.purpose: Event or workshop flyer: navy top field with the hazard band, two host signatures, eyebrow, two-line title and subtitle; left column WHEN / WHERE / WHO facts, activity list and requirements; right column a three-step workflow panel, a tools-covered row and a navy registration panel with a QR code and the printed URL; Letter footer with the trademark line.
layouts.when: Workshops, demo days, tutorials, open labs and any event that needs prerequisites, a short how-it-works and registration. For a photo- or illustration-led event page use ATR-Flyer-Letter.pptx (Event flyer).

placeholders.name: eyebrow
placeholders.purpose: Event type and host or series, ALL CAPS, segments separated by two spaces, a middle dot and two spaces; one line.

placeholders.name: event_title
placeholders.purpose: Event headline, two lines at most. PowerPoint shrinks a longer one; cut words instead.

placeholders.name: event_subtitle
placeholders.purpose: One sentence on what people learn or do and who it is for; two lines.
placeholders.prompt: [One sentence on what people will learn or do and who it is for.]

placeholders.name: event_date
placeholders.purpose: Date in AP style ("Saturday, Nov. 7, 2026"); one line, bold.

placeholders.name: event_time
placeholders.purpose: Time in AP style ("11 a.m.-3 p.m."), with an optional check-in or duration line; up to two lines.

placeholders.name: venue
placeholders.purpose: Building, room and campus; up to three lines. The building name is verified; the room number is a placeholder until confirmed.
placeholders.prompt:
[Mathematical Sciences Building, Room ###]
[Kent State University, Kent, Ohio]

placeholders.name: audience
placeholders.purpose: Who it is for, the experience expected and cost or places; up to three lines.
placeholders.prompt:
[Who should come]
[Prerequisites or experience level]
[Cost  ·  places]

placeholders.name: agenda_title
placeholders.purpose: Heading of the activity list; defaults to "What you will do" when agenda is given.

placeholders.name: agenda
placeholders.purpose: Four one-line activities (what participants will do), as bullets.

placeholders.name: requirements
placeholders.purpose: Requirements and fine print: what to bring, accounts or software needed, supervision, photo release, accessibility; two lines.
placeholders.prompt: [What to bring or have ready; supervision, photo-release or accessibility line.]

placeholders.name: step1
placeholders.purpose: Workflow step 1: a short title (level 1, bold navy, one line) and up to two lines of detail (level 2, slate, about 76 characters; Tab in PowerPoint). Fill all three or the layout's plates show empty; "workflow" in a spec spreads a list over step1-step3.
placeholders.prompt:
[Step 1 title]
	[Up to two lines on what happens]

placeholders.name: step2
placeholders.purpose: Workflow step 2: a short title (level 1, bold navy, one line) and up to two lines of detail (level 2, slate, about 76 characters; Tab in PowerPoint). Fill all three or the layout's plates show empty; "workflow" in a spec spreads a list over step1-step3.
placeholders.prompt:
[Step 2 title]
	[Up to two lines on what happens]

placeholders.name: step3
placeholders.purpose: Workflow step 3: a short title (level 1, bold navy, one line) and up to two lines of detail (level 2, slate, about 76 characters; Tab in PowerPoint). Fill all three or the layout's plates show empty; "workflow" in a spec spreads a list over step1-step3.
placeholders.prompt:
[Step 3 title]
	[Up to two lines on what happens]

placeholders.name: tools_label
placeholders.purpose: Label of the tools row; defaults to "TOOLS COVERED" when tools are given. Delete it when there is no tools row.

placeholders.name: registration_label
placeholders.purpose: Call-to-action label in the navy panel, ALL CAPS; "SCAN TO REGISTER" when there is a QR code.

placeholders.name: registration_head
placeholders.purpose: Deadline or format line ("Sign up by Nov. 5", "Four-hour workshop"); one line.

placeholders.name: registration_url
placeholders.purpose: The clean registration URL printed as plain text (no hyperlink styling: Office link colors fail on navy); one line. Defaults to the QR code's address without https://.

placeholders.name: contact
placeholders.purpose: Contact for questions: a kent.edu address and, optionally, a phone line; two lines.

placeholders.name: registration_qr
placeholders.purpose: Registration QR code, 1.23 in square (navy on white, 4-module quiet zone inside the image, hyperlinked in the digital file). Give {"qr": {"url": ..., "size_in": ...}} or a PNG path; the printed URL goes in registration_url. Leave it out and the panel keeps the text only.

fixed_sets.advice: Give three steps (or remove the workflow and use the Event flyer layout of ATR-Flyer-Letter.pptx).

tools_row.purpose: Tools covered: up to four third-party product icons with plain labels, left-aligned; artwork unmodified (fit, never cropped or recolored).

furniture.signatures: ATR horizontal-short reverse at left, Kent State wordmark at right, on the navy field
furniture.footer: lab line, contact line, trademark line
